title: Heartbreaker's Scourge (unanimated)
description: Changes the netherite sword to be the Heartbreaker's Scourge from Karmatic SMP chapter 2
body:
The unanimated version of the Heartbreaker's Scourge from the Karmatic SMP, featuring the wings of limbo as a guard.
the animated version has blinking eyes, and the wings stretch to become a guard.

visit my patreon if you want to buy the animated one
(ps it will be cleaned up; the centre eye as well as the wings will be much more realistic)
